Chapter on the explanation of the letter ba. Its number is 2, and its expansion is ب ا ل ف ل ا ر. Its numerical expansion is ا ر ح د ا ث ن ي ن ا ر ح د ث ل ا ث و ن ث م ا ن و ن. Thus the number of letters is 23; these were multiplied within themselves and became 149. Then its Ka'b was made rational, which is Danniyyal; this was removed from it, leaving 13. Thus the Ka'b was completed, and the people became Tayya Fina'iyyal.

Chapter on the explanation of the letter dal. Its number is 4 and its letters are dal. When these were broken down and extended, these letters resulted: ا ر ب ع ہ ا ر ح د ث ل ا ث و ن ا ر ح د ا ر ب ث ن. Total 43 letters; these were multiplied and became 409. From this was subtracted 151 and 258 remained. Thus the Ka'b became Ṭiya'iyyal. Another method of derivation is that these were multiplied by the number of the letter dal, becoming 16. Then these were multiplied by the amount of expansion, becoming 48. This was made rational and Qina'iyyal became.

Chapter on the explanation of the letter ha. Its number is 5 and its broken form is ه ا ل ف ا, and its extension is ر خ م س ا ح د ث ا ث و ن. All letters were added together (becoming 22); these were multiplied and yielded 294; this was subtracted, leaving 154. The Ka'b of letters and the hidden patron became Ṭawi Tiya'iyyal. This was the explanation of the manifest, but in the hidden sense, this number was made rational and Miya'iyyal became. These are the four methods of hidden derivation, and without this, derivation is given to Diya'iyyal.

Chapter on the explanation of the letter jim. Its number is three, and its letters are jim, ya, mim. Its expansion is like this: ي م ا ي م ا, and its extension is ث ل ا ث ث ق ر و ا ب ث ن ر ح ث ر ح ا ر ح د ا ر ب ث ن ن ر ث ر ہ ا ر پ ث ن. These total 38 letters. These were multiplied within themselves and yielded 254. From this and its 5, we subtracted and 313 remained. Then the Ka'b became fruit, and the people became Tayya Tiyaṭa'iyyal was created. Another method is that the three letters of jim were multiplied within themselves and became 9, and the letter of 9 is ṭa; we combined this with jim, and the people became Tiyaṭiṭa'iyyal. Then he made the first rational, and the patron became Dasi'iyyal.

Chapter on the explanation of the letter waw. Its number is 6, its expansion is waw, alif, waw, and its extension is س ت ہ ا ر ح د ث ل ا ث ن ث م ا ن و ن س ت ہ ا ر ح د س ت ہ. Total 33 letters; these were multiplied and became 309; from this was subtracted 25 and 284 remained. Tiya'iyyal became patron, and in another way, when we multiplied these, they became 36; then these were made rational and Nuriyyal became the patron created. Then he returned to them and Ṭiya'iyyal became.

Chapter on the explanation of the letter zay. Its number is 7, its expansion is zay, alif, and its extension is س ب ع ہ ا ر ح د ث ل ا ث و ن ث م ا ن ن. All were added together and became 19; then multiplied and became 187; from this was subtracted and Liqa'iyyal became the patron created. This was the explanation of the upper manifest things, and in the hidden sense it is like this: we made the fourth into a Ka'b and multiplied this within it, becoming 112. Ḥisa'iyyal became the patron created, and when the first number was combined, Liiyal became.

Chapter on the explanation of the letter ḥa. Its number is 8, its expansion is like this: ا ا ل ف ا, and when extended, became 43, and from multiplication, 218 resulted. From this was subtracted 158. Tiya'iyyal became manifest as patron, and from the hidden calculation it is like this: the number of the letter ḥa, eight, was multiplied by two, becoming 16; these were multiplied. Wafiya'iyyal's return, or the patron's rational return, Azrayil resulted. These are three methods.
Chapter on the explanation of the letter ṭa. Its number is 9 and its expansion is 22. Multiplied and became 204; thus this was...

Chapter on the exposition of the letter Sin. Its number is 60, and its basit is sin-ya-nun, and its gheiras is 30. Multiplied, 300 results. Joined, 158 results, and Fasa'il was produced. This was apparent, and the esoteric is as follows: when we multiplied the original number, Laqa'i'il appeared, and then from the original, Fati'il was produced.

Chapter on the exposition of the letter Ya. Its number is 10, its basit is ya, and its gheiras is ya-alif. When multiplied, 209 results. When joined, Haqqthi'il was produced. This is the method of the methods, and the inferiorities—that is, the esoteric method—is this: they are ten in number, multiply them by themselves, 100 results. Waqti'il was produced. Then we returned to the apparent number without joining. Ikhti'il was produced. Then we came to the apparent [number], Dari'il occurred.

Chapter on the letter 'Ayn. Its number is 70, its basit is 'ayn-ya-nun, and its gheiras is 36. When multiplied and joined, Risma'il was produced. And the esoteric [method] is this: 'Ayn is 70, multiply them by the number of its letters, that is three, results in 210, and Ghara'il was produced—returning to the original number, Dari'il was produced.

Chapter on the letter Fa. Its number is 80, and its basit and gheiras is fa-alif-lam-alif—36 letters result. After multiplication, it was joined—Rati'il was produced. And the esoteric [method] is this: multiply the original number by 3, Wasq was produced, and Sati'il appeared. Then returning to the original number, Ra'il was produced. Let it be known that each of these muwakkalat holds a wondrous rank, and they have wondrous and strange names.

Chapter on the letter Kaf. Its number is 20, its basit is kaf, and its gheiras is kaf-alif. When the basit was performed, there were 36 letters. Multiplied, 309 results. Datri'il was produced. And by the esoteric method, the original number 20 multiplied by 66 results. Nisa'il was produced. Returning to the original without subtraction, Nisa'il was [again] produced.

Chapter on the letter Lam. Its number is 30, its basit is lam, and its gheiras is lam-alif-mim-alif. Their basit is 181. When joined, Taaqi'il was produced. Then in the esoteric direction, it appeared in thought—Sa'il was produced through derivation. Then returning to the original, Ahya'il appeared.

Chapter on the letter Mim. Its number is 40, and its basit is ya-mim. Subtracted, it becomes 39. Multiplied, 381 results. Joined, 361 results, and A'il was produced. This belongs to the spine of the methods, but the inferior [method] is this: the original number was multiplied into the esoteric number, [Khai'il] was produced. The word of the people of the middle [region]: [Kha'il]. Then returning to the original, Qita'il was produced.

Chapter on the letter Nun. Its number is 50. Subtracted basit, it becomes 53. Multiplied, 425 results. Subtracted in this way, 375 remains. Hati'il was produced. This is the apparent derivation, and the esoteric is as follows: when multiplied, 2500 results. Through derivation, Lakni'il was produced. Returning to the original number, Baiki'il occurred—this manifests in the methods.

Chapter on the letter Qaf. Its number is 100, and its basit is qaf-alif. When multiplied, 356 results. When extracted, Ra'il, the muwakkal, was produced. This was the apparent form. Afterwards, we returned to the original and multiplied its number—300 was obtained. When this was derived, and from the apparent number, the muwakkal Laqa'i'il was produced.

Chapter on the letter Sad. Its number is 90, and its basit and gheiras is 92. When multiplied, 409 results, and the kacba of letters becomes correct. When extracted, Wasi'il appeared. And when the original number was multiplied by the extracted letters, 20 results, and the third muwakkal from the original number, Dari'il was produced.

Chapter: Allah the Exalted is sufficient, and may He grant me success. And know that when your intention is to inquire about the condition of a sick person or a missing person, then first determine on which day he fell ill, or on which day the missing person traveled. Take his name and his mother's name using the method of extended numerical computation (Ḥisāb al-Jummal al-Kabīr), then in the lunar month however many dates have passed, make the numerical values as large as possible, then add further to those numbers on top of them. Divide the total sum of all numbers by nine, then see what remains. If three or less remains, then look at both tablets; whichever of the two it falls into—I have named one the Tablet of Life and the other the Tablet of Death. In whichever tablet the calculation falls, from that one issue the decree regarding death or life. In the same manner, the condition of husband and wife may also be known—whether they will remain together in harmony or in discord—and who among them will die first, by calculating according to the mentioned rule. From the Arabic months, the dates that remain, add them as an increase, and also add their names to them, and divide according to the rule, and place them before the Tablet of Life and the Tablet of Death. If it falls in the Tablet of Life, then they will remain together. If one of them falls in the Tablet of Death, then there will be discord between them or one of them will die. Similarly, when a ruler comes to a city, determine the day on which he entered the city. Calculate with the ruler's name along with the past dates according to the mentioned rule, and place the remainder that remains before both tablets. By its light, whatever becomes apparent regarding death and life, issue the decree accordingly. And similarly is the case of a pregnant woman regarding what she will give birth to and whether the child will remain alive or die.

Chapter: Know that the Name of Majesty (Ism Jalalat) is also the Supreme Name (Ism al-A'zam), and its retreat and seclusion is 66 days. In these, after each prayer you should recite this Name 66 times, and it is obligatory to cultivate within yourself all the external conditions and noble character traits. You should become entirely angelic in character and continuously perform divine remembrance in your heart until a special state from the dhikr descends upon you and you lose awareness of yourself, and your courage becomes elevated. At that time the gates will open before you and earth and heaven will be manifest before your eyes. You will meet the spirits of the prophets and saints, and the unseen matters will come to you in dreams. This is the state of the first retreat. From this retreat you will attain the rank of the dhikr-performers and will be honored with the knowledge of the realities of the divine names.

Chapter: Regarding the exposition of the letters of the alphabet, for these are the foundation of speech and upon them its structure is established. We know that the effects of the unpointed letters are as they are in the alphabet, which contain the mysteries. In a hidden manner, help passes from the higher world to the lower world. The world of the Throne helps the world of the Chair; the world of the Chair helps the sphere of Saturn; the sphere of Saturn helps the sphere of Jupiter; the sphere of Jupiter helps the sphere of Mars; the sphere of Mars helps the sphere of the Sun; the sphere of the Sun helps the sphere of Venus; the sphere of Venus helps the sphere of Mercury; the sphere of Mercury helps the sphere of the Moon; the sphere of the Moon helps the sphere of fire, by means of which the sphere of moisture is taken; the sphere of moisture helps the sphere of cold; the sphere of cold helps the sphere of cohesion; the sphere of cohesion helps the sphere of air. If the air helps you, it helps your dust, for the dust helps the sphere of Saturn. Therefore, for Saturn, the letters in the simple forms are jīm. Its collective number is three (3) and its detailed number is fifty-three (53). Likewise, for mīm it is forty, for yā' it is ten, and for jīm it is three. Saturn also has three letters. In the connected forms, its letter is jīm, and its number is three. In the simple forms there are five, whose letter is hā', and its proportion is the fifth part. The number of the sphere of Jupiter is six (6), and its letter is wāw, and its proportion is the sixth part. As for the sphere of Venus, its letter is ẓā' (z) and its proportion is the seventh part. Regarding the sphere of Mercury, its number is eight and its letter is ḥā' (ḥ). Its proportion is the eighth part. Regarding the sphere of the Moon, its number is nine (9) and its letter is ṭā' (ṭ). Its proportion is the ninth part. The triangle of Saturn (1) is very famous among all people.

Chapter: There is no specific time designated for serving these letters and paying their due; you can do so at any time. When you go into seclusion for them, divide the number of its letter by 30/30; whatever remains is the number of days of seclusion. The luminous days are those [mentioned]. And when any need arises, use that same letter for that need—for example, use Ta for repelling enemies and removing harm, Jim for attraction (obtaining something), Mim for love, and Sin for enmity. Hold fast to piety and consuming the permissible. Change your daily clothes in accordance with the colors of the planets. Sitting in a clean and pure place, busy yourself with supplication until the light comes before you. And at night-time, keep the invocation on your tongue; the client will appear. Its form will be like the shape of the moon. It will address you and fulfill your need. This invocation is useful for every need:

Chapter: When you wish to work with this, first take the Name of God and extract its letters from the earth. Begin first with the Greater Chapter (bab kabir) and derive its letters' calculations, its numerical values, and its degrees from which extraction takes place. Thus the "chapters" will be produced: 60 [plus] 60, changing the "transforming powers" (quwat munqalib) to the chapters of fasting. From this comes the extraction of the speech of the pre-Islamic era that matches the numbers: the chapters of 60 from charity, the corresponding number for the days of a year, the hours of day and night. One method: in 700, the hours are from the chapter of leaven (bab khamir), and the chapter of the spoils (bab al-ghanim) belongs to this name, and in it there are twenty-four letters. Corresponding to the number of the mansions (manazil), the total letters of the names are 900. In the same manner from alif to tha, and from alif to ghayn: each mansion is one name. Then divide these letters into twelve "suns" (sam), and by "sun" is meant the thirty-day stay of the sun in each sign of the zodiac. The total results are twelve. The first source is Aries, and this is the original language and the mother of languages. Then Taurus, then Gemini, and so on.

Section on the explanation of the letter Dhāl. Its number is 700, and its takhsīr is Dhāl-Alif-Mīm, and its expansion is 88. When multiplied, 425 is yielded. When these are subtracted, Luḍiyāyil appeared. When the number is multiplied by the original words, 448 is yielded, and Ḥaniyāyil is produced.

Section on the explanation of the letter Ghayn. Its number is 1000, and its expansion is Gh-Y-N-Ā; in total 22. When multiplied, 304 is yielded. Dirāyil appeared. In the inner, when letters are multiplied with Milāy, twenty-three thousand is yielded. In Plato's doctrine, according to its conformity, it is made rational: Ḥittiyāyil occurred, and according to our doctrine's conformity, Jayyāyil is [the name]. Understand this well with thorough verification, if God wills; you will be successful. As we have previously explained, that the name from the letter Alif has an appropriate numerical correspondence. Similarly, for every letter, one appropriate divine name from among the divine names is extracted, and together with this letter, it will serve as this Supreme Name. We have explained these topics with the utmost clarity. Whoever God wills will obtain benefits from them.

Section on the explanation of the letter Khā'. Its number is 600. When multiplied and istinkā' is performed, 216 is yielded. In the inner, when the original number is multiplied by the first expansion, it becomes 100; Datarnā Tāyil occurred.

Section on the explanation of the letter Shīn. Its number is 300, and its expansion is Sh-Y-N, and its kassra is Sh-Y-N-Ā; in total 41 letters. When multiplied, 404 is yielded. When this is calculated, Siāyil Mūjākil appears, and by the inner calculation, when the number is multiplied by the letters of Ẓafar Jad, 900 is yielded; Ḥiyāyil appeared. When one returns to the first, Dāliyāyil appeared.

Section on the explanation of the letter Thā'. Its number is 500, and its expansion is Thā, and its kassra is Thā-Alif; the total number is 316. When this is subtracted, 215 remain. Dastāyil appeared, and in the inner, when the number is multiplied by the expansion, it becomes 100. Then istinkā' is performed: Ruḥbtāyil appeared, and when Pardāsi is made rational, Datarnā Tāyil appeared.

Section on the explanation of the letter Tā'. Its number is 400, and its expansion is Tā, and the expansion of letters is 28. When these are multiplied among themselves, 824 is yielded. When this is calculated, Waqtiyā Tāyil is produced. The inner aspect is as follows: when the original number is multiplied by the letter Ẓafar Jad, 80 is obtained. Burṭiyā Tāyil appeared. Then when one returns to the first, Danrātāyil occurred.

Section on the explanation of the letter Đād. These are Ẓalmānī letters. Its number is 800, and its takhsīr is Đād, and its expansion is Đād-Alif-Waw; the total number is 45. When multiplied, 425 is yielded. When this is subtracted, Mustaniyāyil occurred. Then the original number is multiplied by the original letters, yielding 24. Ḥaqbayīl is produced from this. Then istinkā' is performed on the original number; Aṭrāyil is produced.

Section on the explanation of the letter Ẓā'. This is a Ẓalmānī letter. Its number is 900, and its expansion is 26. When multiplied, 225 is yielded. When this is calculated, Livāyil is produced. In the inner, after the aforementioned number was 900, when multiplied by letters, 800 is yielded. Sufiyāyil appeared, and from the first number, Ḥukpayil appeared.

Section on the letter Rā'. Its number is 200, and its expansion is Rā-Alif-Fā-Tā, their total 28. When multiplied, it yields 238. When this is subtracted, Diftāyil is produced. When one returns to the inner calculation, there were 200. Multiplying them twice produces Aṭṭāyil, and the apparent one is Mūjākal-Rāyil, and it is called istinkā' of Ḥārith.

Section: On the explanation of Suflī and Anẓarīn, and this is the speech of the degrees of the Father. Then they are established under Zahra and extended. The side of the house of wonder, so their establishment is to arrange the degree in its proper rank, then form it from the intention. Like the way the reins of the beginning of speech are established, with the sincere heart following Zahra's first degree. Then extract the helpers of those gates with the well-known invitation, and prepare them as you wish. These letters are the invitation of the helpers of this gate, which is the second lesser collection, Bābābī. Then return to the speech of obedience, from which Mīsīr and Mīd are meant, and know it by analogy according to the form of the speech of Rashf. It is known that from the Greater Father, which is the gate of Bāyqil and Tyān and Ḥasīb and Aḥmad and Kātib and Sayyūf and Mutaqaddimah and Ṣābir and A'rāḍ and Ghirāmī, and those are Ṭālūk and Asmarā and Farāḥat and Barāṣah and Talāwah and Shatāhid, in the Greater Father there are three peoples: Tārāndā, Laghīr, Makhna, and Murabīgh, through the lineage of Marzubān. And for the purpose of ḥayt, these letters are for calling them: Hū, Qāf, Bā'.
